page.short: Fits 2005-2022 Audi A3, Volkswagen Beetle, CC, Eos, GTI, Jetta, Passat, Rabbit, Tiguan, Tiguan Limited
page.desc: APR Braided Stainless Steel Direct-Fit Brake Line Upgrades are a direct replacement that improves your braking experience with the best lines on the market today. We do away with the factory rubber hoses that expand and can even rupture over time, and replace them with braided 304 stainless steel lines with a smooth-bore Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) / Teflon core that allow for very little expansion. This gives you a firmer brake pedal with less required pedal travel as the fluid gets to its destination faster without all the flex and expansion that happens with lower quality lines. Unlike many universal lines on the market that often use connector adapters, ours are application specific with the correct length and hose fittings, eliminating potential leak points. The lines have an attractive polyvinyl chloride (PVC) outer jacket in smoked clear so you can see the braided lines from within, with red anodized inserts, and Cr3+ steel connectors. Each brake line is fully tested to 3,000 psi prior to sale, which is far beyond typical operating pressures. The lines are independently certified as SAE "low-expansion" lines and average only 0.07 cc/ft @ 1,000 psi and 0.11 cc/ft at 2,900 psi! They are compatible with DOT 3, 4, 5 (silicone-based), and 5.1 brake fluids, are fully DOT-compliant, and meet FMVSS106 and SAE J1401 standards. These are the only brake lines you'll ever need!

page.name: APR Catback Exhaust System - RS4 / RS5 (B9)
page.short: Fits Audi RS4 18-25, RS5 18-25
page.desc:
PLEASE NOTE: Some B9.5 vehicles may be equipped with an updated valve motor. Vehicles with valve actuator P/N 8S0-133-246-D require adapter P/N EXH0712, the required adapter is available at no charge with proof of purchase.

Introducing the APR Catback Exhaust System for the Audi B9 RS4 and RS5

The APR Catback Exhaust System for the Audi B9 RS4 and RS5 is a complete, high-performance exhaust solution that runs the entire length of the vehicle from the catalyst back. This system is engineered to boost performance, elevate sound, and enhance aesthetics with RS-style diamond black oval exhaust tips that are sure to make a statement. Crafted from premium materials and built with advanced manufacturing techniques, this system is designed to withstand harsh conditions and deliver lasting performance. Expect a bold, aggressive growl at wide-open throttle, along with an impressive gain of 9 horsepower and 15 FT-LBS of torque to all four wheels!

Unmatched Design and Precision Engineering

Unlike anything currently available, the APR system includes downpipes extending to the factory catalyst in the upper engine bay, making this a true full-system upgrade. We’ve minimized restrictions with smooth transitions, oversized piping, and straight-through mufflers and resonators. Constructed from mandrel-bent T304 stainless steel with a brushed finish and TIG welding throughout, this exhaust system is as durable as it is striking. Installation is hassle-free, thanks to precision-fit brackets, OEM-style slip clamps, and an included upgraded tunnel brace to accommodate the oversized piping.

Inspired by RS Performance

Like the RS4 and RS5, this system stays with the unique single oversized midpipe design. It utilizes dual 2.75” (70mm) downpipes and midpipes that merge through a cast Y-junction into a massive 3.5” (91mm) midpipe. The integrated Helmholtz resonator minimizes drone through a straight-through design with a sound-canceling port, ensuring no compromise in exhaust flow.

The system splits again via another cast Y into two rear, valve-controlled mufflers with sound absorption technology. These valves are fully integrated with the OEM control system, adjusting automatically to enhance sound during aggressive driving while maintaining a quieter profile during cruising. Finally, exhaust gases exit through dual cast Y-junctions into a quad 2.5” (63.5mm) system, terminating via oversized 7.25”x5” RS-style exhaust tips. The tips feature a diamond black finish and a subtle APR logo for a refined touch.

Experience the APR Difference

Designed for enthusiasts seeking the perfect balance of power, sound, style, and quality, the APR Catback Exhaust System for the Audi B9 RS4 and RS5 is a testament to engineering excellence. With its performance-driven design and durable construction, this system not only transforms your driving experience but also ensures years of reliable performance.

Introducing the APR Rear Catback Exhaust System for the Audi B9 SQ5

The APR Rear Catback Exhaust System for your Audi B9 SQ5 introduces a deeper and more aggressive growl to your vehicle’s exhaust note. The system is a direct bolt on with your factory exhaust system or can be combined with the APR Midpipe Exhaust System for a more refined and more powerful full catback experience! Inspired by the larger center-pipe design of the higher-output RS4 and RS5 models, this system is engineered to boost performance and elevate sound. Crafted from premium materials and built with advanced manufacturing techniques, this system is will withstand harsh conditions and deliver lasting performance. Expect a bold, aggressive growl at wide-open throttle, along with a gain of 5 AWHP and 6 AWFT-LBS or an impressive gain of 10 AWHP and 12 AWFT-LBS when combined with the APR Midpipe Exhaust System!

Unmatched Design and Precision Engineering

Unlike anything currently available, the APR system starts just after the midpipes but can be combined with our midpipe system to making this a true full-system upgrade. We’ve minimized restrictions with smooth transitions, oversized piping, and a straight-through rear muffler / Helmholtz resonators. Constructed from mandrel-bent T304 stainless steel with a brushed finish and TIG welding throughout, this exhaust system is as durable as it is striking. Installation is hassle-free, thanks to precision-fit brackets, OEM-style slip clamps, and an included upgraded tunnel brace to accommodate the oversized piping.

Inspired by RS Performance

Like the RS4 and RS5, this system features a reengineered exhaust routing design. It utilizes a dual 2.75” (70mm) midpipes merging through a cast Y-junction into a massive 3.5” (91mm) midpipe, replacing the restrictive factory dual-pipe setup. The exhaust valve is fully integrated with the OEM control system, adjusting automatically to enhance sound during aggressive driving while maintaining a quieter profile during cruising. When closed, exhaust gasses route through the rear muffler featuring straight-through sound absorption technology and when open, bypasses the rear muffler all together.

Experience the APR Difference

Designed for enthusiasts seeking the perfect balance of power, sound, and quality, the APR Midback Exhaust System for the Audi SQ5 is a testament to engineering excellence. With its performance-driven design and durable construction, this system not only transforms your driving experience but also ensures years of reliable performance.

page.name: APR Turbo Inlet System - 2.0T EA888.4 MQB EVO
page.short: Fits 2022-2024 Audi S3/VW Arteon/Golf R
page.desc:
The APR Turbo Inlet System is a comprehensive upgrade to your factory or modified intake system.To maximize performance addressing the restrictive components between the airbox and turbocharger are a top priority. It's common to individually upgrade these components, but doing so is not ideal as it mean sacrificing overall design for the sake of compatibility. This is why the APR system is one complete upgrade from the turbocharger to the intake airbox.We were able to increase the diameter as large as possible with the best geometry from the turbo to the intake airbox to promote the maximum amount of flow with the lowest pressure drop. The system starts at 80mm and can expand up to 88mm for larger airbox systems. On the Golf R we increased flow by over 30% at each measured inlet depression! This means the turbo doesn't have to work as hard, which translates to lower temperature, and improved performance.This system is compatible with the factory intake airbox, and works perfectly with an APR intake filter for those who prefer a "stealth" OE airbox upgrade. It also pairs perfectly with our myriad of intake airbox only intake systems, such as the APR Carbon Fiber and PEX open systems. Of course, none of these systems compared to the performance potential of the complete APR intake system with modular covers, but the performance is the best you can expect without upgrading all 3 components in one design (turbo inlet elbow, turbo inlet pipe, and airbox).Every aspect of the system has been perfected for performance minded individuals. The hose is wire reinforced so there's no chance it will collapse under heavy load and heat. Since oils from the PCV will eventually work their way into the system, we line the hose with fluorosilicone ensure it's oil and fuel resistant.

The dv connection point is billet and strong hose clamps are included as well as an optional oetiker clamp for an ultra-clean DV reroute connection. And lastly the turbo inlet adapter is removable, giving you the flexibility to grow with this system as you see fit!

Turbo inlet adapter is removable and can be modified for larger turbo setups

page.short: Fits Audi A3 08-13, A3 Quattro 09-13, Q3 15-18, Q3 Quattro 15-18, TT Quattro 09-15 Volkswagen Beetle 12-19, CC 09-17, Eos 09-16, Golf 10-14, GTI 08-14, Jetta 08-18, Passat 08-22, Tiguan 09-17, Tiguan Limited 17-18​
page.desc:
APR High Flow Intake Filters are a direct upgrade to your factory intake system! Typically your engine is equipped with a cheap, mass-produced and restrictive paper filter system that must be replaced several times in the life of the vehicle. The APR Filter uses a proprietary, high-flow, cotton-gauze filtration material that is washable and will likely outlive the vehicle itself! The filtration material was flow-bench optimized to provide maximum performance while also providing excellent filtration that will keep your engine running clean for hundreds of thousands of miles with normal maintenance. With multiple decades of creating and selling high-flow filters for hundreds of thousands of vehicles with our upgraded intake systems, we're confident our line of drop-in filters will be an excellent upgrade for our budget-minded consumers!

In many cases, upgrading the intake system to an APR intake system is the best route to take for maximum performance, but that's not always possible for all vehicles and every budget. That's where our direct replacement filters shine. This is the easiest upgrade you can make to your factory intake system to maximize performance. The filter flows more than stock and has less pressure drop at the same flow rate, which means the engine doesn't need to work as hard to make the same, or more power.

Our drop-in filters are made for all engine types including gas, diesel, ethanol, or other fuels, and naturally aspirated, turbocharged, supercharged, and other hybrid configurations! In every scenario, our filter maximizes performance of the factory intake system. Expect sharper throttle response, a little more sound, and on turbocharged engines, less strain on the turbo with a reduction in turbo lag.

page.name: APR Roll-Control Sway Bar - Front - (FWD MQB/MQB EVO)
page.short: Fits Audi A3 15-25; VW Golf 15-19, GTI 15-25, Jetta 19-25; FWD.
page.desc:
APR Roll-Control Sway Bars are engineered to significantly improve cornering performance by reducing vehicle body roll without greatly impacting comfort. Drivers who enjoy a more spirited driving style often encounter excessive body roll, which negatively impacts handling. During cornering, the vehicle’s body leans to the opposite side, shifting weight primarily to the outside tires. This uneven distribution reduces grip on the inner tires, resulting in decreased overall traction and stability.

Our solution? APR Sway Bars are fine-tuned with an optimized spring rate achieved through increased bar diameter and strategic placement of end-link mounting points forged from a single bar. Additionally, we upgrade the bushings to high-performance polyurethane, eliminating bar movement and compression during hard turns, ensuring consistent and enhanced performance.

APR Sway Bars are designed as a direct replacement for your factory-installed bars. Simply swap out the original bars with our upgraded sway bars to experience improved handling immediately. Whether referred to as stabilizer bars, anti-roll bars (ARB), or sway bars (FSB/RSB), APR’s bars deliver superior cornering control and driving confidence.

Getting Technical:

APR Sway Bars are constructed from high-tensile strength steel, known for its excellent durability properties. To reduce weight without compromising strength, these bars are hollow. Each bar is precision CNC-bent from a single piece of bar stock, eliminating welds and significantly reducing the risk of failure compared to traditional manufacturing methods. The bar ends are forged into shape and then quench-hardened in specialized fixtures to achieve the highest strength profile possible, and then dimensionally confirmed in final check fixtures. Lastly, each sway bar is coated with a corrosion-resistant red powder coat, offering both durability and a sleek appearance.

On this particular model, we’ve increased the bar diameter to 28 mm, with a 4.5 mm wall thickness, an upgrade from the factory’s 24.1x3.9mm (MK7 GTI) and 24.3x4.1m (MK8 GTI) size. This enhancement results in a spring rate of 333/383 lbs/in delivering a 85%/114% and 62%/86% increase over the factory MK7/MK8 GTI bars. These changes translate to significantly improved handling, reduced body roll, and a more responsive driving experience.

Optimize your vehicle’s performance with APR’s precision-engineered sway bars for superior strength and reliability.

Additionally, we upgrade the bushings to high-performance polyurethane, eliminating bar movement and compression during hard turns, ensuring consistent and enhanced performance.

APR Sway Bars are designed as a direct replacement for your factory-installed bars. Simply swap out the original bars with our upgraded sway bars to experience improved handling immediately. Whether referred to as stabilizer bars, anti-roll bars (ARB), or sway bars (FSB/RSB), APR’s bars deliver superior cornering control and driving confidence.

Getting Technical:

APR Sway Bars are constructed from high-tensile strength steel, known for its excellent durability properties. To reduce weight without compromising strength, these bars are hollow. Each bar is precision CNC-bent from a single piece of bar stock, eliminating welds and significantly reducing the risk of failure compared to traditional manufacturing methods. The bar ends are forged into shape and then quench-hardened in specialized fixtures to achieve the highest strength profile possible, and then dimensionally confirmed in final check fixtures. Lastly, each sway bar is coated with a corrosion-resistant red powder coat, offering both durability and a sleek appearance.

On this particular model, we’ve increased the bar diameter to 25 mm, with a 5 mm wall thickness, an upgrade from the factory’s 21.9x3.7 mm size. This enhancement results in a spring rate of 611 lbs/in on the soft setting and 697 lbs/in on the stiffer setting, delivering a 71%/95% increase over the factory MK7 Golf R bar. These changes translate to significantly improved handling, reduced body roll, and a more responsive driving experience.

Optimize your vehicle’s performance with APR’s precision-engineered sway bars for superior strength and reliability.

page.name: APR A02 Flow Formed Wheels (18x8.5) (Hyper Silver) (1 Wheel)
page.short: APR A02 - Flow Formed - 18x8.5 - ET45 - 5x112 - Hyper Silver
page.desc:
APR A02 Flow Formed Wheels pay homage to several classic wheels in a new and unique design that is sure to turn heads! Central to the wheel is a classic 5-spoke pattern that has been hollowed out for weight savings and interlaced inside of a 5-spoke Y pattern that pays respect to the APR A01 wheels. The meshing together of these two iconic designs brings together a snow flake pattern we all love from decades past.

The wheels are flow formed, which means they are strong and light weight, yet cost dramatically less then forged wheels. Finite Element Analysis (FEA) was used to reduce spoke width to reduce weight while providing the strength necessary to achieve a 720 KG load rating. Furthermore, weight saving pockets are cut behind the wheel face to reduce weight.

Strong billet aluminum CNC-machined rings allow the wheels to be compatible with both common center bores, and won't wobble, crack, or crumble like other materials. The center caps are removable and upgradeable and are even compatible with various OEM center caps for a stealth look! The lug bolts are compatible with OEM ball seat lugs, and the barrel has anti-slip machining features to prevent tire-to-wheel rotation.

The A02 wheels are offered in various widths, diameters, offsets, and colors.

page.name: APR A02 Flow Formed Wheels (18x8.5) (Anthracite) (1 Wheel)
page.short: APR A02 - Flow Formed - 18x8.5 - ET45 - 5x112 - Anthracite
page.desc:
APR A02 Flow Formed Wheels pay homage to several classic wheels in a new and unique design that is sure to turn heads! Central to the wheel is a classic 5-spoke pattern that has been hollowed out for weight savings and interlaced inside of a 5-spoke Y pattern that pays respect to the APR A01 wheels. The meshing together of these two iconic designs brings together a snow flake pattern we all love from decades past.

The wheels are flow formed, which means they are strong and light weight, yet cost dramatically less then forged wheels. Finite Element Analysis (FEA) was used to reduce spoke width to reduce weight while providing the strength necessary to achieve a 720 KG load rating. Furthermore, weight saving pockets are cut behind the wheel face to reduce weight.

Strong billet aluminum CNC-machined rings allow the wheels to be compatible with both common center bores, and won't wobble, crack, or crumble like other materials. The center caps are removable and upgradeable and are even compatible with various OEM center caps for a stealth look! The lug bolts are compatible with OEM ball seat lugs, and the barrel has anti-slip machining features to prevent tire-to-wheel rotation.

The A02 wheels are offered in various widths, diameters, offsets, and colors.

page.name: APR Floating and Self Leveling Center Cap - Silver
page.short: Direct plug and play upgrade on APR wheels and other wheels.

page.name: APR Brakes - Replacement Pads - Advanced Street / Entry-Level Track Day
page.short: Fits APR 6 Piston Brakes. Direct replacement Advanced Street / Entry-Level Track Day brake pads.
page.desc: This compound will offer similar characteristics to our High-performance Street compound in terms of having a slightly rising torque curve during a single application. It will offer a little less initial bite as you engage the brake pedal under normal street driving conditions. This material also takes a little longer to bed in and prefers to be run at slightly higher operating temperatures in order to maintain the friction film that is put down on the disc surface during the bed-in procedure. This material can be run to higher max operating temperatures than our standard High-Performance Street compound while remaining fade-free. The additional heat range means that this compound can be used for entry-level track days. This makes this material a good choice for customers that would like to take part in occasional track days but do not want to change pads prior to these events.

Plug and play with APR big brake kits

page.name: APR Brakes - Replacement Pads - Advanced Track Day
page.short: Fits APR 6 Piston Brakes. Direct replacement Advanced Track Day brake pads.
page.desc: This compound is specifically aimed at advanced track day users and offers full race performance under track conditions. While it can be used to drive to and from the track, some brake squeal will be experienced during street driving. It is not recommended that this pad material be used for extended daily street use as accelerated disc wear and brake noise will be experienced during daily street driving. On track this compound will offer unmatched brake performance and fade resistance and will be a significant step up over our Advanced Street / Entry-level Track Day compound. The material remains kind to discs under track conditions and pad wear is low. It has a slightly rising torque curve and modulation remains excellent. A mechanical retention system is employed between the pad backing plate and the friction material for maximum shear resistance during high-temperature use. Advanced track day users will really appreciate the characteristics, performance and wear life that this compound offers. For advanced track day customers that also use their car as a daily driver we suggest a two-pad strategy in which you run our High-Performance Street compound for daily street use and then switch to our Advanced Track Day material for track events.
features: Optimal temperature range: 100-800 deg C (212-1472 deg F)
Best choice for advanced track day use
Can be used to drive to and from track events but brake squeal and increased disc wear will be experienced if used for daily street driving
Plug and play with APR big brake systems

page.desc: APR OE Replacement Advanced Street Pads are a direct upgrade for your factory brake. This pad material will remain fade free to operating temperatures that far exceed typical OE pads. The material has a high friction co-efficient but is engineered to deliver torque curves that will extract the most from street-legal tires without overwhelming them and causing premature wheel lockup. The fairly low thermal conductivity of this friction material slows the rate of heat transfer to the brake calipers, pressure seals and brake fluid. This pad compound delivers the type of pedal feel and fade resistance that are normally associated with entry-level race pads but it also delivers very good cold response and low disc wear, which a race pad would not when used on a street car. They pair perfectly with the APR Direct Replacement Brake Discs, and provide a no-compromise solution for spirited daily driving.

page.name: APR Braided Stainless Steel Brake Lines (Set of 2) - Rear
page.short: Fits Audi A3 Quattro 06-13, A3 06-13; VW Golf R 12-13, Eos 07-16, R32 08, GTI 06-14, CC 09-17, Beetle 12-19, Rabbit 06-09, Jetta 05-18, Golf 10-14, Passat 06-13
page.desc: APR Braided Stainless Steel Direct-Fit Brake Line Upgrades are a direct replacement that improves your braking experience with the best lines on the market today. We do away with the factory rubber hoses that expand and can even rupture over time, and replace them with braided 304 stainless steel lines with a smooth-bore Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) / Teflon core that allow for very little expansion. This gives you a firmer brake pedal with less required pedal travel as the fluid gets to its destination faster without all the flex and expansion that happens with lower quality lines. Unlike many universal lines on the market that often use connector adapters, ours are application specific with the correct length and hose fittings, eliminating potential leak points. The lines have an attractive polyvinyl chloride (PVC) outer jacket in smoked clear so you can see the braided lines from within, with red anodized inserts, and Cr3+ steel connectors. Each brake line is fully tested to 3,000 psi prior to sale, which is far beyond typical operating pressures. The lines are independently certified as SAE "low-expansion" lines and average only 0.07 cc/ft @ 1,000 psi and 0.11 cc/ft at 2,900 psi! They are compatible with DOT 3, 4, 5 (silicone-based), and 5.1 brake fluids, are fully DOT-compliant, and meet FMVSS106 and SAE J1401 standards. These are the only brake lines you'll ever need!

page.name: APR Catback Exhaust System
page.short: Fits 2015-2017 Volkswagen GTI MK7
page.desc: The APR Catback Exhaust System personalizes your vehicle's looks, sound and performance. Beautifully hand-crafted T304-stainless-steel components adorn the system with stunning TIG-welding throughout. Our straight-through brushed-finished mufflers are configurable to your desire, smoothing the exhaust note to a deep growl, without adding restrictions, rasp or drone. Strong high-quality bracketry and OEM-style clamps hold the system steadily in place, making the install or removal a snap, and fitment simple, yet precise. A cast 3" to dual 2.5" rear splitter creates an ultra-smooth transition, steadily feeding exhaust gasses out of the system, while looking tidy from under the rear bumper. Finally, removable 4" polished slash-cut exhaust tips finish the system, adding a classy motorsport-inspired touch to the rear of the vehicle.System OverviewOur exhaust system uses larger piping compared to the factory exhaust system, yet weights 5 lbs. less and 1 lb. less with the optional front muffler. We use 3" OD piping, which then splits to a dual 2.5" design. The factory system uses 2.56" piping, which reduces to 2.36" before splitting, greatly diminishing the overall diameter of the system. Finally, our system's 4" exhaust tips dwarf the factory 3.15" tips, giving the rear of the vehicle a sportier look.

page.name: APR Catback Exhaust System - S4 / S5 (B9)
page.short: Fits Audi S4 18-25, S5 18-25
page.desc:
Introducing the APR Catback Exhaust System for the Audi B9 S4 and S5

The APR Catback Exhaust System for the Audi B9 S4 and S5 is a complete, high-performance exhaust solution that runs the entire length of the vehicle from the catalyst back. Inspired by the larger center-pipe design of the higher-output RS4 and RS5 models, this system is engineered to boost performance, elevate sound, and enhance aesthetics with customizable exhaust tips that are sure to make a statement. Crafted from premium materials and built with advanced manufacturing techniques, this system is designed to withstand harsh conditions and deliver lasting performance. Expect a bold, aggressive growl at wide-open throttle, along with an impressive gain of 10 horsepower and 12 FT-LBS of torque to all four wheels!

Unmatched Design and Precision Engineering

Unlike anything currently available, the APR system includes downpipes extending to the factory catalyst in the upper engine bay, making this a true full-system upgrade. We’ve minimized restrictions with smooth transitions, oversized piping, and straight-through mufflers and resonators. Constructed from mandrel-bent T304 stainless steel with a brushed finish and TIG welding throughout, this exhaust system is as durable as it is striking. Installation is hassle-free, thanks to precision-fit brackets, OEM-style slip clamps, and an included upgraded tunnel brace to accommodate the oversized piping.

Inspired by RS Performance

Like the RS4 and RS5, this system features a reengineered exhaust routing design. It utilizes dual 2.5” (63.5mm) downpipes to dual 2.75” (70mm) midpipes pipes merging through a cast Y-junction into a massive 3.5” (91mm) midpipe, replacing the restrictive factory dual-pipe setup. The integrated Helmholtz resonator minimizes drone through a straight-through design with a sound-canceling port, ensuring no compromise in exhaust flow.

The system splits again via another cast Y into two rear, valve-controlled mufflers with sound absorption technology. These valves are fully integrated with the OEM control system, adjusting automatically to enhance sound during aggressive driving while maintaining a quieter profile during cruising. Finally, exhaust gases exit through dual cast Y-junctions into a quad 2.5” (63.5mm) system, terminating in 3.5” (91mm) lightweight, single-walled motorsport-style tips. The tips feature a polished stainless steel finish and a subtle APR logo for a refined touch.

Experience the APR Difference

Designed for enthusiasts seeking the perfect balance of power, sound, style, and quality, the APR Catback Exhaust System for the Audi B9 S4 and S5 is a testament to engineering excellence. With its performance-driven design and durable construction, this system not only transforms your driving experience but also ensures years of reliable performance.

page.name: APR Catback Exhaust System - RS6 / RS7 (C8)
page.short: Fits Audi RS6 21-25, RS7 21-25
page.desc:
Introducing the APR Catback Exhaust System for the Audi C8 RS6 and RS7

The APR Catback Exhaust System for the Audi C8 RS6 and RS7 is a complete, high-performance exhaust solution that runs the entire length of the vehicle from the catalyst back. This system is engineered to boost performance, elevate sound, and enhance aesthetics with RS-style diamond black oval exhaust tips that are sure to make a statement. Crafted from premium materials and built with advanced manufacturing techniques, this system is designed to withstand harsh conditions and deliver lasting performance. Expect a bold, aggressive growl at wide-open throttle, along with an impressive gain of 9 horsepower and 16 FT-LBS of torque to all four wheels!

Unmatched Design and Precision Engineering

The APR system includes downpipes extending to the factory catalyst in the upper engine bay, making this a true full-system upgrade. We’ve minimized restrictions with smooth transitions, cast inlets, oversized piping, and straight-through mufflers and resonators. Constructed from mandrel-bent T304 stainless steel with a brushed finish and TIG welding throughout, this exhaust system is as durable as it is striking. Installation is hassle-free, thanks to precision-fit brackets and OEM-style slip clamps.

RS Performance

The entire system is increased to a dual 3” (72mm) exhaust path. With the exhaust valves open, the exhaust gasses travel uninterrupted from the front of the system out through the exhaust tips. When exhaust gasses travel into the multichambered rear muffler / resonator, they continue uninterrupted and a Helmholtz resonator reduces drone frequences without restricting flow on the open-valve path. With the valves closed, exhaust gasses travel through a sound reduction path via a smaller 2.5” (63.5mm) pipe, reducing volume and allowing the system to act more civilized when needed. Finally the system terminates via oversized 8.23”x4.76” (211x21mm) RS-style oval exhaust tips. The tips feature a diamond black finish and a subtle APR logo for a refined touch.

Experience the APR Difference

Designed for enthusiasts seeking the perfect balance of power, sound, style, and quality, the APR Catback Exhaust System for the Audi C8 RS6 and RS7 is a testament to engineering excellence. With its performance-driven design and durable construction, this system not only transforms your driving experience but also ensures years of reliable performance.

page.name: APR Catback Exhaust System
page.short: Fits 2022-2025 Volkswagen Golf R MK8
page.desc:
Introducing the APR MK8 Golf R Catback Exhaust System—a masterpiece crafted by enthusiast engineers who were given complete freedom to create an unparalleled exhaust system. The mission was clear: design the ultimate system that enthusiasts would desire. Prioritizing quality, style, sound, and features while keeping it accessible and affordable. Our team poured immense effort and months of development into this project. The result? A system that sets the gold standard for MK8 Golf R catback exhaust systems, and anyone who’s experienced it knows exactly why!The first thing that catches your eye is the system’s stunning appearance. The quality is evident at a glance—constructed from brushed T304 stainless steel with oversized 3” tubing that elegantly splits into quad 2.5” exits. Precision mandrel bending ensures a free-flowing design, while the matte carbon fiber quad tips add a touch of luxury typically reserved for vehicles twice the price! The system is packed with premium features: robust TIG welding and precision-engineered bracketry guarantee a perfect fit and alignment on every vehicle, every time. Our low-profile clamps simplify the installation, saving you time and money. Plus, the interchangeable tips offer customization options should you wish to switch up the look in the future.But it’s the sound of this system that truly excites us. At wide-open throttle, the exhaust unleashes a ferocious roar, yet it remains refined and civilized during daily driving and cruising.

This perfect balance is achieved through straight-through tubing, OEM-controlled exhaust valves, dual Helmholtz resonators, and the absence of sound-absorbing materials that could alter the pure exhaust tone. When you floor the throttle, the valves open, channeling exhaust gases through a straight, unrestricted path, maximizing power and preserving the exhilarating soundtrack. However, when you’re cruising around town or embarking on a long highway journey, the valves close, and the Helmholtz resonators work their magic, canceling out unwanted drone frequencies as sound waves collide within the offset tubing. This isn’t just theory—our engineers utilized advanced 3D sound spectrographs to analyze and fine-tune the system’s frequencies, eliminating the tones nobody wants to hear. The result is a tone that’s as pleasant as it is powerful, ensuring an enjoyable driving experience for you and your passengers. Now that’s what we call Performance Without Compromise!

Unrestricted Performance: The straight-through 3” (76mm) to quad 2.5” (63.5mm) mandrel-bent tubing ensures maximum exhaust flow. 100% unrestrictive design with valves open significantly outperforms the factory system, which narrows to 50mm.

page.short: Fits 2017-2020 Audi RS3 and 2018-2022 Audi TT RS
page.desc:
The APR Turbocharger Inlet System outflows the factory components by up to 45%, and jumps to 60% when adding the APR Intake Filter. This is firstly achieved through elimination of the most critical restriction in the entire intake system, the turbocharger inlet pipe. Because of this restriction, no intake airbox / filter design can physically match the gains achieved by upgrading to the APR Turbo Inlet System alone. This inlet is the first step one should take when upgrading their intake system and paves the way for even more gains by adding the optional intake filter.The APR Turbocharger Inlet System uses a massive 4" carbon fiber inlet tube that attaches to the factory airbox, or the APR Intake Filter System. Attached to the carbon fiber tube is a massive 4" cast aluminum inlet which is organically shaped to retain the largest possible cross-sectional area within the pipe all the way to the inlet of the turbocharger's compressor cover. Despite the visually odd shape, keeping the cross-sectional area as large as possible is the key to the pipe's performance gains, and greatly outflows smooth looking continuously tapering designs.Interlocking adapter rings form a port-matched ideal entrance to the turbocharger, while larger rings (sold separately) provide port-matched support for even larger hybrid turbocharger upgrades. A thick stainless-steel heat shield protects the pipe from the hot turbocharger manifold, and an external stainless PCV pipe provides proper PCV placement without impacting the inlet's design.Finally, adding the optional APR Intake Filter completely transforms the system from subtle to extreme.

Our massive 9" long cotton filter with frontal opening connects to a 6" carbon fiber inlet tube that gradually necks down to the 4" back tube. You will hear every ounce of the 5-cylinder turbocharger system's massive demand for airflow, and you'll do so at a 60% CFM improvement over stock! This was only possible with an open filter system as the airflow demands called for an unboxed design. Simply put, this is the best intake system on the market for satisfying uncompromisingly demanding airflow requirements.

page.name: APR Intake System - 2.9T RS4/RS5 (B9)
page.short: Fits Audi RS5 18-25
page.desc:
Introducing the APR Full Intake System for the Audi RS4 and RS5 (B9) 2.9T EA839

APR is proud to unveil the Full Intake System for the Audi RS4 and RS5 (B9) 2.9T EA839—an all-in-one solution designed to deliver maximum airflow, enhanced turbocharger efficiency, and real, measurable performance gains.

The APR Full Intake System is perfect for Audi enthusiasts seeking the ultimate intake upgrade. Unlike others that address only a portion of the intake system, requiring the inlets and outlets to neck down to the factory diameter for compatibility, this comprehensive solution replaces every component from the inlet scoop to the turbocharger inlet. This eliminates restrictions throughout the system, ensuring unmatched airflow and turbo performance with the largest inlet physically possible.

Key to the system’s superior performance is its optimized design. Making the inlet as large as possible is the goal but space is extremely limited. By maximizing the internal diameter with thin-walled heat-resistant composite materials, APR achieves an impressive 31% more airflow compared to stock. This translates directly into improved turbocharger efficiency, faster spool times, and significant power gains, adding +19 AWHP and +17 AWFT-LBS of torque on our APR Stage 1 (93) equipped RS5.

Additionally, the APR Full Intake System is engineered with functionality, performance, and sound in mind. The PEX airbox shields the filter from the engine bay, while its thoughtfully placed cutouts provide additional airflow and a refined engine sound. A massive 7” x 7” washable pleated cotton gauze filter further enhances performance with vast filtration surface area while ensuring long-lasting usability.

Whether you’re focused on unlocking power, enhancing turbo performance, or future-proofing your vehicle for upgrades, the APR Full Intake System is the only intake you’ll ever need.

Testing Results That Speak for Themselves

The performance of the factory intake system is no match for the APR Full Intake System. The stock setup is limited to a maximum flow of 484 CFM at 28” H2O, whereas our full intake system achieves a significant 36% improvement, flowing 658 CFM under the same conditions.

This increase in airflow is paired with a dramatic reduction in pressure drop across the system, allowing the turbocharger to spool faster and operate in a more efficient range of its compressor map. The result is not just theoretical—it’s power you can feel.

On our Stage 1 (93) tuned Audi RS5, simply installing the APR Full Intake System delivered an additional +19 AWHP and +17 AWFT-LBS of torque, proving its capability to unlock your vehicle’s full potential.

page.desc:
The APR 4.0T EA825 Intake System is here for the Audi (C8) RS6 and RS7!The APR Intake System is a substantial upgrade for the 4.0T EA825 engine. It offers significant horsepower and torque gains through a high flow design that greatly increases airflow while reducing pressure drop.We've upgraded every part that actually translates to increased performance. Throttle response sharpens, as the system lets your engine to breath more freely. This causes the turbochargers to work less hard, which directly translates to the gains you feel. On top of that, the stunning carbon fiber and aluminum design looks fantastic in the engine bay and adds a pleasant auditory note to the engine. The filter is washable and reusable, and the cast aluminum turbo inlets use adapter rings with ideal entrances, making them compatible with larger turbochargers. This lets the system support even higher airflow levels, with low pressure drop, and even more horsepower and torque as you continue to mod!Design Overview and Testing:There was no component overlooked in the search for performance; the airbox, filter, couplers, and turbo inlets were each extensively analyzed and modified for maximum flow. The upgraded APR filter unit, featuring a low restriction cotton gauze media, flows 8% more than stock without sacrificing air quality. Flow is further improved by 52% larger airbox outlets, and 93% larger turbo inlets. The significantly improved APR turbo inlets are compatible with turbos featuring up to a 29% larger inlet port; various inlet adapters ensure that the APR intake will provide optimized flow for a wide range of turbos. Overall flow improvements of the intake result in a 50% reduction in pressure drop compared to OEM. The APR intake flows 19% less than the theoretical maximum supported by the OEM turbo inlet port diameter; a significant improvement compared to the OEM intake which flows 37% less than the theoretical maximum.

Such significant improvements in flow quality and quantity are manifested in faster throttle response, reduced strain on the turbo, and increased efficiency which translates to more power. On the Stage 1 (93) APR RS6, an additional 47 AWHP and 38 AWFT-LBS of torque, to all four wheels, was measured on our calibrated chassis dynos. Whether you are looking to improve the performance of your stock RS6, or pushing the limits with larger turbos, the APR intake will support your efforts.

page.name: APR Carbon Fiber Intake System - 4M/9Y 4.0T
page.short: Fits 2020-2026 Audi RS Q8/SQ7/SQ8 - 2019-2026 Bentley Bentayga/Lamborghini Urus/Porsche Cayenne
page.desc:
The Ultimate Intake System for the 4.0T EA825 V8 SUV Engine

Our 4.0T EA825 V8 Intake System for SUV models offers an OEM+ appearance upgrade with an intake plenum (the air chamber prior to the engine's cylinders) in a stunning matte forged carbon finish that enhances airflow by up to 22% compared to stock. The enhanced turbocharger inlets feature a bell mouth profile that directly connects to the factory turbocharger, promoting optimal flow and facilitating easy upgrades to future turbos. The system incorporates a proprietary performance intake filter with a high-flow cotton gauze filtration material and a flow-bench optimized design that significantly improves airflow through the system and into the intake plenum. This filter surpasses stock performance by up to 12% and reduces pressure drop at the same flow rates, alleviating the turbochargers’ strain and maximizing overall performance. Additionally, it sharpens throttle and turbocharger response, resulting in a more responsive driving experience. This intake system is the pinnacle of performance for the 4.0T EA825 V8 engine, powering SQ7, SQ8, RSQ8, Bentley Bentayga, Porsche Cayenne, and Lamborghini Urus.

The Design

The 4.0T SUV’s engine bay design is compact. The factory employs a dual inlet design that feeds into an airbox positioned beneath the intake filter cover, which then feeds into a multi-part turbocharger plenum. Airflow is directed 180 degrees into turbo inlet adapters and both turbochargers.

The intake filter underwent optimization on the flow bench to maximize airflow while utilizing a filter media that provided adequate filtration and extended filter life. Through several design revisions verified on the flow bench, we increased CFM by up to 12% over the stock unit! The overall shape and design of the filter resemble the factory unit due to its location, but it internally features several enhancements to enhance airflow beyond simply changing filter media. Next, the turbocharger plenum was upgraded. The factory plenum is small and features a flow-restricting split-body design. We eliminated this and replaced it with a large, organically shaped single-body design to promote airflow. Forged Carbon fiber was used not only for its aesthetic appeal but also because it allows for thin walls and complex geometry to maximize cross-sectional area. This aids in airflow and reduces pressure drop. The APR plenum is significantly larger than the factory unit in various areas and is a single-piece design that extends past the integrated PCV and EVAP bungs and runs all the way down to the new billet aluminum high-flow turbocharger inlets - less restriction, more airflow to the engine.

The billet aluminum turbocharger inlets feature a bell-mouth profile to promote airflow. If upgrading to larger turbochargers, the inlets can be modified or replaced to match the compressor cover on the new turbochargers. Furthermore, this system integrates PCV and EVAP bungs for a seamless installation. New EVAP jet pumps were designed and supplied for proper emission control despite all this power increase. All these improvements result in an upgrade that’s worthy of the 4.0T’s engine bay. The intake system allows the engine to breathe more freely, maximizing performance and giving a subtle but enhanced burliness to the engine note that’s sure to delight the discerning ear.

page.desc: The APR Open PEX Intake System is the best dollar-per-horsepower intake system for the 1.4T Engine! This directly translates to more power you can feel. Our 1.4T test vehicle saw an additional and 11 WFT-LBS of torque and 8 WHP compared to stock! These are solid gains that make a noticeable difference in performance!

page.name: APR Turbo Inlet System - 2.0T EA888.4 GTI/A3 (MQB EVO)
page.short: Fits Audi A3 22-24, Audi A3 Quattro 22-24, VW GTI 22-24
page.desc:
The APR Turbo Inlet System is a comprehensive upgrade to your factory or modified intake system.

To maximize performance addressing the restrictive components between the airbox and turbocharger are a top priority. It's common to individually upgrade these components, but doing so is not ideal as it mean sacrificing overall design for the sake of compatibility. This is why the APR system is one complete upgrade from the turbocharger to the intake airbox.

We were able to increase the diameter as large as possible with the best geometry from the turbo to the intake airbox to promote the maximum amount of flow with the lowest pressure drop. The system starts at 80mm and can expand up to 88mm for larger airbox systems. For any given size inlet there is a theoretical maximum flow limit, but in real world testing the actual results are typically around 90%. On the GTI we set out to achieve this limit and hit 90% of the ideal maximum with the APR turbo inlet! This means the turbo doesn't have to work as hard, which translates to lower temperature, and improved performance.

This system is compatible with the factory intake airbox, and works perfectly with an APR intake filter for those who prefer a "stealth" OE airbox upgrade. It also pairs perfectly with our myriad of intake airbox only intake systems, such as the APR Carbon Fiber and PEX open systems. Of course, none of these systems compared to the performance potential of the complete APR intake system with modular covers, but the performance is the best you can expect without upgrading all 3 components in one design (turbo inlet elbow, turbo inlet pipe, and airbox).

Every aspect of the system has been perfected for performance minded individuals. The hose is wire reinforced so there's no chance it will collapse under heavy load and heat. Since oils from the PCV will eventually work their way into the system, we line the hose with fluorosilicone ensure it's oil and fuel resistant. And lastly the turbo inlet adapter is removable, giving you the flexibility to grow with this system as you see fit!
features: Increase in flow to 90% of the ideal maximum, lower pressure drop, optimized performance over stock
Full system addresses all restrictions between the turbocharger and airbox
Wire-reinforced hose lined with fluorosilicone for oil and fuel resistance
Fits 80mm and 88mm airboxes
Perfect upgrade for the factory airbox or upgraded “airbox only” intake systems
Turbo inlet adapter is removable and can be modified for larger turbo setups
page.meta: Full turbo-to-airbox inlet upgrade for the 2022-2024 VW GTI and Audi A3 2.0T EA888.4. Starts at 80mm, expands to 88mm for lower pressure drop and cooler charge.

page.name: APR Carbon Fiber Intercooler Ducts - Porsche 911 (992) 3.0T
page.short: Fits Porsche 911 2020-2024
page.desc:
APR Carbon Fiber Intercooler Ducts for the Porsche 992 3.0T dramatically lower intake air temperature (IAT) by increasing air flow through the ambient air path of the intercooler cores. In doing so the engine makes more power and sustains power levels for longer as IAT is kept away from the knock threshold of the engine and IAT based power reduction safety routines of the factory ECU. Multiple back-to-back wide-open-throttle acceleration tests proved our intercooler ducts reduced IAT as much as 9.6°C (17.3°F) or 15% better than stock!

The APR Intercooler ducts are made from carbon fiber allowing the cooling ducts to be formed to the exact shape necessary to fit into the tight engine bay within the 992's rear end. The vents allow for maximum flow through the system, while continuing to connect the system to the rest of the factory ducting. Everything simply slides into place with no extra hardware required. A gorgeous matte finish with a gloss APR logo adorns the system, giving it a motorsport inspired feel, which is unfortunately tucked out of view with the rear bumper installed.

Testing:

The 911 must be tested on the street, rather than a dyno, to capture real world cooling data. This is especially true because of the rear engine design. In real world driving, air is forced through the cooling ducts differently than it is on a stationary dyno, even with excellent cooling fans.

During development APR Engineers fully instrumented the engine to find the limitations of the factory hardware. It was quickly determined the factory intercoolers struggled with airflow through the ambient cooling paths. By redesigning the cooling ducts, more high pressure ambient air could be forced through the system to maximize effectiveness of the coolers.

To illustrate their importance, wide open throttle acceleration tests were conducted for roughly 11 seconds, both with stock cooling ducts and APR cooling ducts. IAT was measured post intercooler with high quality thermocouples. Ten back-to-back tests were conducted with each setup, and the results were averaged together. With the stock ducts in place, IAT rose to 66.2°C (151.2°F). This is above the factory knock threshold of 60°C (140°F) and is approaching the ECU power reduction limiter at 70°C (158°F). Once this IAT threshold is crossed, the ECU will begin aggressively reducing engine power to protect the engine. By simply swapping to the APR intercooler ducts, IAT dropped 15%, or 9.6°C (17.3°F), leveling off at 56.6°C (133.9°F). This is below the knock threshold and safely away from the power reduction threshold!

APR Intercooler ducts are a simple and cost effective upgraded to the 992 3.0T and should be considered by any customer, at any stage of performance, looking to maximize the performance of their 911!

page.name: APR Ignition Coil & Spark Plug Kit (2.0T EA888.3, EA888.4 4-cylinder engines)
page.short: APR Ignition Coil & Spark Plug Kit (2.0T EA888.3, EA888.4 4-cylinder engines) - RED
page.desc:
Refresh your ignition system in one shot with an APR Coils & Plugs Pack—matched high-output ignition coils and iridium spark plugs engineered to work together for a stronger, more consistent spark. Each kit is a direct-fit upgrade designed to support smoother idle, sharper throttle response, and reliable performance under heat and load—whether you’re stock or running higher boost and power upgrades.

ENGINEERED AS A SYSTEM: This package pairs APR high-output ignition coils with APR Iridium Pro spark plugs selected for your 4-cylinder application to deliver a stronger, more consistent spark and a complete ignition refresh in one box.

ENERGY OUTPUTS: APR ignition coils increase energy output by up to 10% over stock to help provide a stronger and more consistent spark. Iridium electrodes require less voltage to fire and support stable combustion as cylinder pressures increase.

A DIRECT-FIT UPGRADE: Direct plug-and-play coil replacement plus direct-fit iridium spark plugs—no wiring, coding, or tuning changes required. Always verify spark plug size, reach, gap, and heat range before installation.

HIGH-TEMP DURABILITY: Coils are engineered with upgraded internal components and batch-tested for reliability. Spark plugs feature an iridium electrode and copper core construction for efficient heat dissipation; heat range 9 is designed to support consistent performance in high-heat and high-load conditions.

COMPATIBILITY: Configured for the engine family listed above using spark plug heat range 9. Spark plug OEM cross-reference: 06H905601A, 06Q905601E, 101905631G. Ignition Coil Direct replacement for OEM stock part numbers 06H905110G, 06H905110L, 06H905110P, 06K905601B, 06K905601L, 06K905601M, 06K905611C, 06M905606F, 06Q905601, 06Q905601E, 079905110R, 0P2905601, 0P2905601A, 9A790560100, 9A790560101. Always confirm fitment by application guide and visually confirm connector/boot style before installation.

TRUSTED IN THE US: Founded in 1997, APR is headquartered in Opelika, Alabama and has become a global leader in quality, reliable performance aftermarket products for Volkswagen, Audi, Porsche, and other vehicles.

Includes: 4 ignition coils (MS100192) + 4 iridium spark plugs (Z1003100).
features: APR IGNITION COILS:
14% more energy output than stock
Increased copper winding diameter with reduced resistance
Increased neodyminum magnet size and strength
Red housing with APR Logo
True upgrade, not just aesthetic
Direct plug-and-play
Batch tested to over 73 hours or 15,768,000 coil firings
1 year unlimited-mile direct-replacement warranty
APR IRIDIUM PRO SPARK PLUGS:
Heat range 9 spark plug (Similar: Bosch 3, Brisk 10, Denso 27, and NGK 9)
152% higher melting point than silver, 125% higher than copper, and 38% higher than platinum.
Designed for high performance / tuned vehicle applications
Lower required supplied voltage
Cooler operating temperature than stock plugs
Optimized electrode design for hard to ignite fuels, such as ethanol
Resists preignition better than stock plugs
Perfect for upgraded APR vehicles
Made in the EU
page.install: PLEASE NOTE - If your factory ignition coils look physically different, other than color, these upgrades are not compatible. For models with shorter ignition coil boots (ex: 1.4T), your factory ignition coil rubber boot must be swapped over to the APR ignition coil.

page.desc:
Introducing the APR Midpipe Exhaust System for the Audi B9 SQ5

The APR Midpipe Exhaust System for your Audi B9 SQ5 introduces a deeper and more aggressive growl to your vehicle's exhaust note. The system is a direct bolt on with your factory exhaust system or can be combined with the APR Rear Catback Exhaust System for a more refined and more powerful full catback experience! Crafted from premium materials and built with advanced manufacturing techniques, this system is designed to withstand harsh conditions and deliver lasting performance. Expect a bold, aggressive growl at wide-open throttle, along with a gain of 5 AWHP and 6 AWFT-LBS or an impressive gain of 10 AWHP and 12 AWFT-LBS when combined with the APR Rear Catback Exhaust System!

Unmatched Design and Precision Engineering

The APR System includes downpipes and midpipes that travel post-catalyst in the engine bay to the underside of the vehicle, eliminating the factory resonators in the process. We've minimized restrictions with smooth transitions, oversized piping, and no mufflers or resonators. Constructed from mandrel-bent T304 stainless steel with a brushed finish and TIG welding throughout, this exhaust system is as durable as it is striking. Installation is hassle-free, thanks to precision-fit brackets, and OEM-style slip clamps designed in both a reducing setup for use with the factory exhaust, or straight style for use with our midback system.

Experience the APR Difference

Designed for enthusiasts seeking the perfect balance of power, sound, style, and quality, the APR Midpipe Exhaust System for the Audi SQ5 is a testament to engineering excellence. With its performance-driven design and durable construction, this system not only transforms your driving experience but also ensures years of reliable performance.

page.name: APR High Pressure Fuel Pump - 2.0T EA113
page.short: Fits 2006-2008 Audi A3 - 2005-2008 Audi A4/A4 Quattro - 2008-2009 Audi TT - 2009-2015 Audi TTS Quattro - 2007-2016 VW Eos - 2012-2013 VW Golf R - 2006-2009 VW GTI - 2006-2010 VW Jetta/Passat
page.desc:
The APR High Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP) increases maximum volume of fuel the HPFP can deliver by 41% over stock! In doing so, the direct injection fueling system is capable of satisfying fueling requirements set forth by high horsepower setups. This is accomplished by increasing the displacement of the pump using high quality components to exacting tolerances.How the direct injection system works:A low pressure fuel pump (LPFP) in the fuel tank delivers fuel to the high pressure fuel pump (HPFP) at roughly 4 to 6 bar. Fuel pressure is then bumped up to a maximum of 110-130 bar, depending on factory parts, with the HPFP. Finally, high pressure fuel is delivered to the injectors, which spray directly into the cylinders.The problem:The volume of fuel the HPFP pump can displace is directly tied to the displacement of the pump (Internal bore size, and cam shaft dictated stroke), and engine speed. The pump is driven off of a three lobe cam shaft, and as such, the pump cycles at 1.5 times the engine speed. Even the factory K03 and K04 turbochargers are capable of taxing this system, especially in the mid to lower RPM range where fuel volume is lower.The APR solution:We dramatically increase the volume of fuel the HPFP can displace at every RPM by increasing the displacement of the HPFP. This is accomplished by increasing the bore diameter of the pump's internal pressurizing cylinder. It's important to understand, despite the name, a HPFP upgrade is not necessary designed to increase the engine's fuel rail pressure. The primary goal is to increase the volume of fuel available, which will keep fuel pressure steady even in the most demanding of situations!High quality components and extreme tolerances:The HPFP internals must be machined to extreme tolerances and installed in a clean environment or the pump can easily fail. Dimensional tolerances on the APR HPFP are as tight as .00004" and geometric tolerances are as tight as .00005".

The plunger and barrel are created from certified and heat-treated bearing-grade stainless steel and the plunger undergoes a special diamond like coating process for exceptional surfaces hardness and ultra-reliable operation. To prevent float associated with altering the plunger's mass, APR supplies each unit with a properly specified spring. All internal seals are replaced, including the spring seal, and the tip of the pump retains the factory pivoting head to reduce cam follower wear and piston side loading.Internal testing:All APR HPFPs are assembled in house under strict assembly guidelines. Each pump is then tested on our test rig to ensure the pumps operate as designed. This step is important for several reasons. It's critical in determining if a pump has a failure from incorrect install, a leaking seal, or a bad solenoid. Secondly, a seized pump on the vehicle at startup can cause damage to the engine's camshaft. By testing each pump, we all but eliminate these possibility.Proven track record:APR pioneered HPFP upgrades in the early days of VAG direct injection engines. Soon after, APR became an OEM supplier of HPFP and GDI components to VAG for use in various race cars, racing series, project cars, and concept vehicles. The APR HPFP has been at the center of countless motorsport victories across the globe and has operated with a nearly perfect tract record since the program's motorsport backed inception in 2006. With tens of thousands of pumps sold, APR has a wealth of knowledge, and manufacturing expertise necessary to deliver a product that will and has stood the test of time.OEM Components:Critical to the design of the APR HPFP is the use of only genuine Hitachi components, made in Germany, which consists of sensors, pump bodies, and other critical components that must operate with OEM levels of reliability. All APR components are made in the USA using medical grade precision machinery.

page.desc:
The APR High Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP) increases maximum volume of fuel the HPFP can deliver by 41% over stock! In doing so, the direct injection fueling system is capable of satisfying fueling requirements set forth by high horsepower setups. This is accomplished by increasing the displacement of the pump using high quality components to exacting tolerances.

How the direct injection system works:

A low pressure fuel pump (LPFP) in the fuel tank delivers fuel to the high pressure fuel pump (HPFP) at roughly 4 to 6 bar. Fuel pressure is then bumped up to a maximum of 110-130 bar, depending on factory parts, with the HPFP. Finally, high pressure fuel is delivered to the injectors, which spray directly into the cylinders.

The problem:

The volume of fuel the HPFP pump can displace is directly tied to the displacement of the pump (Internal bore size, and cam shaft dictated stroke), and engine speed. The pump is driven off of a three lobe cam shaft, and as such, the pump cycles at 1.5 times the engine speed. Even the factory K03 and K04 turbochargers are capable of taxing this system, especially in the mid to lower RPM range where fuel volume is lower.

The APR solution:

We dramatically increase the volume of fuel the HPFP can displace at every RPM by increasing the displacement of the HPFP. This is accomplished by increasing the bore diameter of the pump's internal pressurizing cylinder. It's important to understand, despite the name, a HPFP upgrade is not necessary designed to increase the engine's fuel rail pressure. The primary goal is to increase the volume of fuel available, which will keep fuel pressure steady even in the most demanding of situations!

High quality components and extreme tolerances:

The HPFP internals must be machined to extreme tolerances and installed in a clean environment or the pump can easily fail. Dimensional tolerances on the APR HPFP are as tight as .00004" and geometric tolerances are as tight as .00005". The plunger and barrel are created from certified and heat-treated bearing-grade stainless steel and the plunger undergoes a special diamond like coating process for exceptional surfaces hardness and ultra-reliable operation. To prevent float associated with altering the plunger's mass, APR supplies each unit with a properly specified spring. All internal seals are replaced, including the spring seal, and the tip of the pump retains the factory pivoting head to reduce cam follower wear and piston side loading.

Internal testing:

All APR HPFPs are assembled in house under strict assembly guidelines. Each pump is then tested on our test rig to ensure the pumps operate as designed. This step is important for several reasons. It's critical in determining if a pump has a failure from incorrect install, a leaking seal, or a bad solenoid. Secondly, a seized pump on the vehicle at startup can cause damage to the engine's camshaft. By testing each pump, we all but eliminate these possibility.

Proven track record:

APR pioneered HPFP upgrades in the early days of VAG direct injection engines. Soon after, APR became an OEM supplier of HPFP and GDI components to VAG for use in various race cars, racing series, project cars, and concept vehicles. The APR HPFP has been at the center of countless motorsport victories across the globe and has operated with a nearly perfect tract record since the program's motorsport backed inception in 2006. With tens of thousands of pumps sold, APR has a wealth of knowledge, and manufacturing expertise necessary to deliver a product that will and has stood the test of time.

page.name: APR Boost Tap - EA113/EA888 Gen 1/2
page.desc:
APR is pleased to present a modular Boost Tap and PCV Bypass System for your 2.0T engine.

The APR Modular Boost Tap and PCV Bypass System plugs directly into the intake manifold and makes several configuration options available. The APR Modular Boost Tap features a tap used for referencing boost or vacuum from the manifold and a cap if this feature is unneeded. A T-junction allows for multiple boost and vacuum references and a 'no buzz' restrictor pill allows for proper manual boost gauge operation. The system also includes a threaded PCV plug, allowing the PCV system to operate as intended by the OEM, as well as blocked off if needed for a specific PCV or catch-can setup. Furthermore, temporarily installing the threaded plug allows for quick diagnosis of the PCV valve for boost leaks. This innovative and modular design ensures operation with all boost, vacuum and PCV system combinations, leaving no compatibility worries for future configurations.

page.name: APR Low Pressure Fuel Pump - 2.0T EA113/EA888 Gen 1 (AWD)
page.short: Fits Volkswagen Golf R 12-13
page.desc:
The APR Low Pressure Fuel Pump (LPFP) Upgrade is designed to ensure the low pressure fueling system is capable of delivering the proper volume of fuel from the fuel tank to the high pressure fueling system under high demand situations.

Challenges to upgrading the LPFP:

- Very little room for upgraded pump

- OEM Pump requires a PWM signal

- OEM pump controller overheats with high output pumps

- Upgraded OEM pump controller not fully compatible

- ECU modifications may be required

- Secondary controllers often rely on physical boost signals

The factory LPFP sits in a basket submerged in the vehicle's gas tank. The pump operates off of a pulse-width modulated (PWM) signal sent from the pump's control module, which is mapped in the ECU. As fueling demand increases and decrease, the PWM signal adjusts to send only the required amount of fuel through the pump. Unfortunately upgrading the LPFP is not a simple drop in task. The pump's factory enclosure presents some packaging constraints limiting clean expansion to a larger unit. Likewise, doing so often results in overheating and subsequent protective shut down of the factory control unit as it's operating outside of its intended design. This is even true when installing larger and expensive factory units like those found on high output vehicles, such as the Audi TT RS and RS3. Furthermore, upgrading the LPFP control module with the matching expensive higher output control units present other issues as the controller receives CAN messages from integrated vehicle componentry not common on vehicles requiring an upgraded LPFP.

The APR Solution:

- Inline fuel pump

- Fuel pump controller with proper ECU CAN bus communication

- Clean mounting brackets included

- Direct bolt on with no software required

- APR took a multi-step approach to solving the low pressure fueling system and is pleased to present a clean and accurately controlled solution for high horsepower applications.

The APR LPFP System features a 255 LPH high-pressure inline fuel pump that sits between the HPFP and the factory LPFP. The included APR Auxiliary ECU sits on the factory CAN bus and receives critical operating information from the factory ECU to accurately control the pump. As fueling demands increase and decrease, the APR Auxiliary ECU controls output of the pump to deliver the desired volume of fuel to the HPFP. By connecting to the factory CAN bus, the APR Auxiliary ECU eliminate the need for less sophisticated and often problematic methods of controlling the upgraded pump. Because the pump only runs when needed, less power is consumed, fuel temperature is lower and noise, especially at idle, is essentially non-existent. Finally, with the fuel line disconnected, with the click of a button the APR Auxiliary ECU allows the user to quickly and easily empty the vehicle's fuel tank to make way for switching to higher octane fuels or for dry storage and transportation.

page.name: APR High Pressure Fuel Pumps - B7 RS4
page.short: Fits Audi RS4 07-08
page.desc:
The APR High Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP) increases maximum volume of fuel the HPFP can deliver by 41% over stock! In doing so, the direct injection fueling system is capable of satisfying fueling requirements set forth by high horsepower setups. This is accomplished by increasing the displacement of the pump using high quality components to exacting tolerances.

How the direct injection system works:

A low pressure fuel pump (LPFP) in the fuel tank delivers fuel to the high pressure fuel pump (HPFP) at roughly 4 to 6 bar. Fuel pressure is then bumped up to a maximum of 136 bar, depending on factory parts, with the HPFP. Finally, high pressure fuel is delivered to the injectors, which spray directly into the cylinders.

The problem:

The volume of fuel the HPFP pump can displace is directly tied to the displacement of the pump (Internal bore size, and camshaft dictated stroke), and engine speed. The pump is driven off of a camshaft. Upgraded supercharger and turbocharger systems are capable of taxing this system, especially in the mid to lower RPM range where fuel volume is lower.

The APR solution:

We dramatically increase the volume of fuel the HPFP can displace at every RPM by increasing the displacement of the HPFP. This is accomplished by increasing the bore diameter of the pump's internal pressurizing cylinder. It's important to understand, despite the name, a HPFP upgrade is not necessary designed to increase the engine's fuel rail pressure. The primary goal is to increase the volume of fuel available, which will keep fuel pressure steady even in the most demanding of situations!

High quality components and extreme tolerances:

The HPFP internals must be machined to extreme tolerances and installed in a clean environment or the pump can easily fail. Dimensional tolerances on the APR HPFP are as tight as .00004" and geometric tolerances are as tight as .00005". The plunger and barrel are created from certified and heat-treated bearing-grade stainless steel and the plunger undergoes a special diamond like coating process for exceptional surfaces hardness and ultra-reliable operation. To prevent float associated with altering the plunger's mass, APR supplies each unit with a properly specified spring. All internal seals are replaced, including the spring seal, and the tip of the pump retains the factory pivoting head to reduce cam follower wear and piston side loading.

Internal testing:

All APR HPFPs are assembled in house under strict assembly guidelines. Each pump is then tested on our test rig to ensure the pumps operate as designed. This step is important for several reasons. It's critical in determining if a pump has a failure from incorrect install, a leaking seal, or a bad solenoid. Secondly, a seized pump on the vehicle at startup can cause damage to the engine's camshaft. By testing each pump, we all but eliminate these possibility.

Proven track record:

APR pioneered HPFP upgrades in the early days of VAG direct injection engines. Soon after, APR became an OEM supplier of HPFP and GDI components to VAG for use in various race cars, racing series, project cars, and concept vehicles. The APR HPFP has been at the center of countless motorsport victories across the globe and has operated with a nearly perfect tract record since the program's motorsport backed inception in 2006. With tens of thousands of pumps sold, APR has a wealth of knowledge, and manufacturing expertise necessary to deliver a product that will and has stood the test of time.

OEM Components:

Critical to the design of the APR HPFP is the use of only genuine Hitachi components, made in Germany, which consists of sensors, pump bodies, and other critical components that must operate with OEM levels of reliability. All APR components are made in the USA using medical grade precision machinery.

page.desc:
Through countless years of professional racing, APR Motorsport identified the factory shifter cable bracket system as a source of sloppy shifts, missed gears, bracket and bushing failure and even transmission failure. The factory shifter cable bracket is made from plastic with rubber bushings. Over time the bushings wear out, and during long races, heat can cause the bracket to flex and break. To alleviate all issues related with the factory design and not just some, APR's Mechanical Engineers created the ultimate and final upgrade: The APR Solid Shifter Cable Bracket.

The APR Solid Shifter Cable Bracket is made from cast 304 stainless steel and eliminates the rubber bushings with solid, CNC-machined mounting points. The bracket and bushings will not wear out over time or fatigue under heat and prolonged use, minimizing the potential for transmission damage. With the play and rubbery slop of the OEM component removed, it's easier to find gears. Expect the feedback from each shift to remain true and confident with a more direct and solid feeling.

page.name: APR Turbo Muffler Delete
page.short:
Fits 2015-2020 Audi A3 - 2009-2022 Audi A4/A5/A6/A7 - 2013-2016 Audi Allroad - 2019-2024 Audi Q3 - 2011-2022 Audi Q5 - 2017-2022 Audi Q7 - 2015-2020 Audi S3 - 2016-2023 Audi TT/TTS - 2019-2021 VW
Arteon - 2018-2023 VW Atlas - 2015-2019 VW Golf - 2015-2021 VW GTI - 2019-2024 VW Jetta - 2017-2021 Porsche Macan
page.desc:
All too often OEM components must sacrifice various performance minded characteristics in an effort to appeal to a wide variety of customers. While an enthusiast typically wants better boost response and more power, all while hearing the turbocharger breathe, a non-enthusiast may give up these characteristics for a quieter ride. In the case of the factory IHI turbocharger, a turbo muffler, or Pulsations-schalldämpfer, is positioned at the compressor outlet and is designed to reduce engine bay acoustics. The APR Turbo Muffler Delete replaces the factory muffler with a straight, uninterrupted piece, CNC-machined from billet aluminum and anodized black. To ensure proper sealing, APR's engineers took a two-part approach. A Viton seal is included and forms a seal between the base of the muffler housing and the new piece. With the seal in place and the outer flange installed, the muffler delete tube screws into place, forming a full, uninterrupted path for airflow.

APR's 2-Piece Design Explained: As is true with all machined parts, it's impossible to make all parts the same. In the case of the turbo muffler housing, the distance between the bottom and top of the muffler's housing will vary from turbo to turbo. The acceptable measurement range is known as a tolerance. The nominal distance between the top and bottom of the turbo muffler's mounting points is roughly 51 mm. The tolerance on this part can be as loose as +/- .5mm or more. This means some muffler housings will be up to 51.5mm tall, or as low as 49.5mm tall. Since the distance between the top and bottom of the muffler chamber will be different on every turbo, a 1-piece turbo muffler delete will always be either too tall or too short. On systems that are too tall, the delete will touch the bottom but will not touch the top mounting point, creating an imperfect seal and potential for a boost leak. If the part is too short, the system will seal at the top, but will leave a small gap at the bottom, thus negating the purpose of the part as illustrated in the diagram below. APR's 2-piece design solves this issue with an adjustable height design. While a 2-piece design is more difficult and expensive to manufacture, it's the only way to ensure an accurate fit and perfect seal. APR provides a Viton seal that's placed at the bottom of the muffler housing. The muffler cover is then installed forming a seal with the factory gasket. Then, the center tube is inserted and screwed into place to the desired depth, compressing against the Viton seal to ensure a leak proof seal in every scenario. Finally Tension from the seal prevents the tube from coming loose, and the included Loctite provides extra security from movement. With the turbo muffler deleted, the APR design provides a smooth, turbulence free, and leak proof path for airflow existing the turbo!

page.name: APR Boost Tap - 1.8T / 2.0T EA888 Gen 3 MQB
page.desc:
Traditionally boost is tapped by spacing out the factory T-MAP sensor on top of the intake manifold. However, APR's engineers discovered using this location lead to inconsistencies in intake air temperature readings and potentially a loss of power. Upon this discovery, APR's engineering team went back to the drawing board and came up with a new and unique solution.

Utilizing the included punch tool on a warm engine, a boost and vacuum reference port is easily spread opened on the factory intake manifold. The billet aluminum boost tap then connects to the port and uses dual Viton o-ring seals for leak free operation. The reference hoses connect to the rear of the tap via a barbed stainless steel connection point and conveniently routes through the engine bay.

In addition to the boost tap, APR provides several extra components to help suit each individual's needs. For those requiring more than one reference source, a T-fitting allows for more tapping points. In the case where a mechanical boost gauge is used, the brass restrictor pill limits flow and cures gauge buzz. Just less than 100 inches of 200 PSI hose is included with OEM style ear clamps and black cable ties to allow for neatly routing hose through the engine bay
